About.title: About Us
About.intro: Daksh Janaseva Samsthe is a dedicated non-profit organization committed to uplifting the marginalized and driving sustainable social change in Kalaburagi.
About.missionDesc: To empower individuals and communities through accessible healthcare, quality education, and sustainable livelihood programs, fostering an environment of equality and justice.
About.visionDesc: A society where every individual has access to basic human rights, opportunities for growth, and the ability to lead a life of dignity.
About.obj2: Provide educational support to underprivileged children.
About.obj3: Organize regular health camps in rural areas.
About.obj4: Promote environmental sustainability through tree plantation.
